diagnosis: The Driver added deploy-targets.yaml as a new file in this GREEN cycle. That file configures the honest-GREEN verify to start the app via 'make run' (runs 'uv run --env-file .env uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000') and poll http://localhost:8000/ before running the test suite. The uvicorn process did not bind to port 8000 within the 60-second ready_timeout_seconds. The AC itself (dropping inventory_code) does not change any app startup code path — models.py, routes, services, and database.py are all correctly updated and do not reference inventory_code. The app startup failure is orthogonal to the column drop. Root cause: on first invocation, 'uv run' must resolve and possibly install/sync the virtual environment before uvicorn can start; this initial setup likely exceeds the 60-second timeout. The Driver attempted 2 fix passes without success.
fix: In the Makefile 'run' target, add 'uv sync --all-extras' as an explicit step before starting uvicorn so the venv is guaranteed ready before the 60-second polling window begins: replace the current two-line 'run' body with three lines: (1) @lsof -ti:8000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true, (2) uv sync --all-extras, (3) uv run --env-file .env uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000. Alternatively increase ready_timeout_seconds in deploy-targets.yaml from 60 to 120.
